ll cnt[32][32], minDiff;
vector< pair<ll,ll> > upPath[32][2], downPath[32][2];

void recordPaths(int x, int y, ll gain, ll c1, ll c2, bool dir) {
    if (x + y == R + n) {
        upPath[x][dir].emplace_back(gain, c1);
        if (c2) downPath[x][dir].emplace_back(gain, c2);
        return;
    }
    recordPaths(x+1, y, gain + (!dir ? A[x+1][y] : 0), c1, (path[x+y] != 'B' ? c2 : 0), dir);
    recordPaths(x, y+1, gain + (dir ? B[x][y+1] : 0), c1, (path[x+y] != 'A' ? c2 : 0), dir);
}

void searchForward(int x, int y, ll gain, bool dir) {
    if (x + y == R + n) {
        if (upPath[x][dir].empty()) return;
        auto it = lower_bound(upPath[x][dir].begin(), upPath[x][dir].end(), make_pair((totalPaths+1)/2 - gain, 0LL));
        for (int idx = 0; idx < 2; ++idx) {
            int j = it - upPath[x][dir].begin() - idx;
            if (j >= 0 && j < (int)upPath[x][dir].size() && upPath[x][dir][j].second > 0) {
                ll diff = abs((upPath[x][dir][j].first + gain) * 2 - totalPaths);
                if (diff < minDiff) minDiff = diff;
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    if (x > 0) searchForward(x-1, y, gain + (!dir ? A[x][y] : 0), dir);
    if (y > 0) searchForward(x, y-1, gain + (dir ? B[x][y] : 0), dir);
}

ll result;

void searchBackward(int x, int y, ll gain, bool dir) {
    if (x + y == R + n) {
        auto it = lower_bound(downPath[x][dir].begin(), downPath[x][dir].end(), make_pair((totalPaths+1)/2 - gain, 0LL));
        for (int idx = 0; idx < 2; ++idx) {
            int j = it - downPath[x][dir].begin() - idx;
            if (j >= 0 && j < (int)downPath[x][dir].size() && downPath[x][dir][j].second > 0) {
                ll diff = abs((downPath[x][dir][j].first + gain) * 2 - totalPaths);
                if (diff == minDiff) result += downPath[x][dir][j].second;
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    if (x > 0 && path[x+y-1] != 'B') searchBackward(x-1, y, gain + (!dir ? A[x][y] : 0), dir);
    if (y > 0 && path[x+y-1] != 'A') searchBackward(x, y-1, gain + (dir ? B[x][y] : 0), dir);

void compress(vector<pair<ll,ll>>& vec) {
    if (vec.empty()) return;

    ll sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)vec.size(); ++i) {
        sum += vec[i].second;
        if (i == (int)vec.size()-1 || vec[i].first != vec[i+1].first) {
            vec[k++] = {vec[i].first, sum};
            sum = 0;
        }
    }
    vec.resize(k);

            if (j != n && path[i+j] != 'A') cnt[i][j+1] += cnt[i][j];

        if (path[i+R-1] != 'A') recordPaths(i, R, B[i][R], Comb[i+R-1][R-1], cnt[i][R-1], true);
    }
    for (int i = R; i <= n; ++i)
        for (int d = 0; d < 2; ++d) {

            compress(downPath[i][d]);
        }
